## Problem

What behavior or documentation needs to change? Link a related issue if useful.

## Change

Describe the change and why it addresses the problem. Explain any effect on JavaScript semantics, evidence identity, adapter behavior, or project boundaries.

## Checks and evidence

Record the commands actually run, source revision, relevant configuration, and results. For captures, say whether they came through the interface or a harness. Include the original failure and a control case when relevant. Explain checks that could not run.

## Limits and origin

Describe unresolved risks, unsupported cases, or missing evidence. Identify external code or adapted material and its license; preserve required notices. Use safe synthetic examples and keep sensitive information in the security reporting channel.
